findings.title: The set_role endpoint takes the role string from the request payload and writes it directly to the database without validating against allowed roles, which can cause key errors or arbitrary invalid role values when ROLE_RANK is accessed.
findings.explanation: The set_role admin endpoint accepts any role string from the request payload and persists it to the database without validating it against the allowed roles ("customer", "staff", "admin"). When a user with an invalid or arbitrary role attempts to perform actions or when check_role runs, looking up the invalid role in ROLE_RANK will raise a KeyError, causing a server error.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate that payload['role'] is one of the allowed roles (e.g. in ROLE_RANK) before updating the database.
